<div class="card-body">
'''Silence Is Golden''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">沈黙は金</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">2フォース消費して場の自分の側に配備する。どちらのプレイヤーもその場所にドロイドがいるロケーションには“リアクション”として移動してきたり、カードを配備することができない。「アクセス・リンク」（インタラプト）によってキャンセルされる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Silence-Is-Golden-PSA-88099872.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「すみません、船長。申し上げ……」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Silence Is Golden.

'''Card text:'''
Use 2 Force to deploy on your side of the table. Neither player may move as a react to, or deploy cards to, a location where a droid is present. Canceled by Access Link (Interrupt).

'''Lore:'''
Excuse me, captain. I would like to say...

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese names the canceling card Access Link (Interrupt), not Scomp Link Access.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Silence Is Golden]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
